scope: Local disposable PostgreSQL; real repository routines with synthetic auth/storage and fixture-granted entitlements. No browser, provider or hosted acceptance.

findings.description: The live-only creation path publishes a joinable batch with zero sessions. Learning-enabled completion requires a same-subject published session, so the completion UI has no selectable mapping and completion cannot succeed.
Republishing a meeting-only edit invalidates the current publication mapping; Admin must reconfirm mapping before completion.

resultInterpretation: 26 assertions completed; one reproducible product dead end and one mapping-reconfirmation friction. Passing assertions include expected rejection that reproduces the dead end; this is not full workflow acceptance.

commands.scope: Actual repository migrations and routines on isolated local PostgreSQL; final corrected harness.
Actual TypeScript contracts and server adapters executed with mocked identity/RPC I/O; not browser execution.

attempts: Initial sandbox execution could not spawn pg_ctl; approved local-socket execution used.
First fixture assertion incorrectly expected stale-completion PT409 before a matching old mapping existed; actual missing-mapping denial was safe.
After an old mapping was added to test republish behavior, the stale-completion expectation was corrected to Publication changed. Final run passed all assertions.
limitations: No browser-to-real-database session was exercised by this agent.
Synthetic local Auth/Storage catalogues are not hosted Supabase Auth or Storage.
Fixture-granted product access does not prove Razorpay payment, webhook or capacity settlement.
No existing personal accounts, private env files or hosted data used.
Human usability and final hosted acceptance remain separate.
Concurrent multi-Admin operation was not added to this connected runner.
